title: Dual-Key Shape and Color Selection
written_solution: A singleton shape key chooses which family of green(3) objects to recolor: blue(1) selects L-triominoes, yellow(4) selects plus-shapes. A singleton color key (2, 6, or 8) gives the new color. Recolor only the selected family to the color key.
